# Vendored files

The designer bundles these files so it works without internet access.

| Files | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `lucide/sprite.svg`, `lucide/tags.json` | [lucide-static](https://www.npmjs.com/package/lucide-static) 1.52.0 | ISC (`lucide/LICENSE`) |
| `fonts/TitilliumWeb-*.ttf` | [Google Fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/titilliumweb) | SIL OFL 1.1 (`fonts/OFL-TitilliumWeb.txt`) |
| `fonts/Inter.ttf` | [Google Fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/inter), variable | SIL OFL 1.1 (`fonts/OFL-Inter.txt`) |
| `fonts/Roboto.ttf` | [Google Fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/roboto), variable | SIL OFL 1.1 (`fonts/OFL-Roboto.txt`) |
| `fonts/Hind-*.ttf`, the designer's UI font | [Google Fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/hind) | SIL OFL 1.1 (`fonts/OFL-Hind.txt`) |
| `fonts/Oswald.ttf` | [Google Fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/oswald), variable | SIL OFL 1.1 (`fonts/OFL-Oswald.txt`) |

To update the icons, download the same three files from a newer
`lucide-static` version and change the version in this table.
